name: skill-vv
description: Verification and validation for skills, across vendors. Before a skill's first real use in a session, surfaces its requirements and offers install or configuration, then checks whether the current model and platform have passed the skill's V&V procedures and offers to run them. State lives in a VV.md file with YAML frontmatter beside each skill; a Node CLI reads and records it for any agent, and a SessionStart hook runs the check on Claude Code.
